      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --max-width: 1200px;
      --transition: 200ms ease;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--gray-900);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    /* ===== HEADER ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      color: white;
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .btn-login {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-login:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-900);
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .hamburger-icon {
      width: 22px;
      height: 16px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .hamburger-icon span {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 250ms ease;
      transform-origin: center;
    }

    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
    }
    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
    }

    /* Mobile nav */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 64px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 99;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: opacity 250ms ease, transform 250ms ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: all;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 14px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 160px 24px 100px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(118,56,250,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -150px;
      left: -150px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,122,0,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .hero h1 .gradient-text {
      background: var(--gradient-hero);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(118,56,250,0.4);
    }

    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .btn-primary svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    /* ===== SECTION LAYOUT ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES ===== */
    .features {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .content-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .content-card-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .content-card-text p {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      transition: gap var(--transition);
    }

    .section-link:hover { gap: 10px; }

    .section-link svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    .content-card-visual {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
    }

    .visual-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .features .content-card-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #A855F7 50%, #D946EF 100%);
    }

    .features .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 180px;
      height: 180px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      top: 20%;
      right: 15%;
    }

    .features .visual-placeholder::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      bottom: 15%;
      left: 10%;
      transform: rotate(15deg);
    }

    /* ===== SAFETY ===== */
    .safety {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .safety .content-card {
      direction: rtl;
    }

    .safety .content-card > * {
      direction: ltr;
    }

    .safety .content-card-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4 0%, #3B82F6 50%, #6366F1 100%);
    }

    .safety .section-link {
      color: #3B82F6;
    }

    .safety .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 100px;
      height: 100px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 25%;
      left: 20%;
    }

    .safety .visual-placeholder::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 30%;
      left: 25%;
    }

    /* ===== CREATORS ===== */
    .creators {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creators .content-card-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #FB923C 40%, #FBBF24 100%);
    }

    .creators .section-link {
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .creators .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 200px;
      height: 200px;
      border-radius: 40%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      top: 10%;
      right: 5%;
      transform: rotate(25deg);
    }

    /* ===== TAGLINE BANNER ===== */
    .tagline-banner {
      padding: 80px 24px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tagline-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 300px;
      height: 300px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tagline-banner::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px;
      right: -80px;
      width: 250px;
      height: 250px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tagline-banner h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== NEWS ===== */
    .news {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      padding: 96px 0;
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      padding: 0 24px;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .news-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .news-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
    }

    .news-view-more {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      white-space: nowrap;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: gap var(--transition);
    }

    .news-view-more:hover { gap: 10px; }

    .news-view-more svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .news-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .news-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding: 0 24px 16px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 340px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }

    .news-card-thumb {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(1) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #D946EF 100%);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(2) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #FBBF24 100%);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6 0%, #06B6D4 100%);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(4) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #34D399 100%);
    }

    .news-card-thumb-icon {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 20px 24px 24px;
    }

    .news-card-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== CTA DOWNLOAD ===== */
    .cta-download {
      padding: 96px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .cta-download-inner {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .cta-download h2 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .cta-download h2 .gradient-text {
      background: var(--gradient-hero);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .cta-download .subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .store-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: transform var(--transition), background var(--transition);
      min-width: 180px;
    }

    .store-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      background: var(--black);
    }

    .store-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .store-btn svg {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-btn-text {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .store-btn-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: 0.7;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .store-btn-name {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      padding: 64px 24px 32px;
    }

    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .footer-columns {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color var(--transition);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-col a .ext-icon {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .footer-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-700);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .footer-lang {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-300);
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-lang:hover { border-color: var(--gray-500); }

    .footer-lang svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .footer-social a svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-legal .sep {
      color: var(--gray-600);
      font-size: 13px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-columns {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav { display: block; }
      .btn-login { display: none; }

      .hero { padding: 120px 20px 72px; }

      .content-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
      }

      .safety .content-card {
        direction: ltr;
      }

      .content-card-visual { order: -1; }
      .section { padding: 64px 20px; }

      .tagline-banner { padding: 56px 20px; }

      .news { padding: 64px 0; }
      .news-header { padding: 0 20px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; }
      .news-carousel { padding: 0 20px 12px; }
      .news-card { flex: 0 0 290px; }

      .footer-columns {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 28px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .cta-download { padding: 64px 20px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .header-inner { padding: 0 16px; }
      .hero { padding: 110px 16px 56px; }
      .section { padding: 56px 16px; }
      .news-header { padding: 0 16px; }
      .news-carousel { padding: 0 16px 12px; gap: 16px; }
      .news-card { flex: 0 0 270px; }

      .store-buttons { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
      .store-btn { width: 100%; max-width: 280px; justify-content: center; }

      .footer-columns { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer { padding: 48px 16px 24px; }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

    /* Focus visible */
    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <header class="header" role="banner">
    <div class="header-inner">
      <a href="#" class="logo" aria-label="SnapFrame home">
        <span class="logo-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="4"/>
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/>
            <circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        SnapFrame
      </a>

      <div class="header-actions">
        <a href="#" class="btn-login" role="button">Log in</a>
        <button class="hamburger" id="hamburgerBtn" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="mobileNav">

          <span class="sep">·</span>

          <a href="#">Sitemap</a>
        </div>

  <script>
    (function() {
      var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      var mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
      var isOpen = false;

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        hamburger.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
        mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
        document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
      });

      var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a');
      mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
        link.addEventListener('click', function() {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        });
      });

      // Close on escape
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          hamburger.focus();
        }
      });

      // News carousel touch/drag support
      var carousel = document.querySelector('.news-carousel');
      var isDragging = false;
      var startX, scrollLeft;

      carousel.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        isDragging = true;
        carousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        startX = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        scrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var x = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        var walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
        carousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
      });
    })();
  </script>

      color: var(--gray-400);

      background: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .footer-social a svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);

    }

    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--white); }

      color: var(--gray-600);
      font-size: 13px;
      user-select: none;

    (function() {
      var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      var mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
      var isOpen = false;

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        hamburger.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
        mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
        document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
      });

      var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a');
      mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
        link.addEventListener('click', function() {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        });
      });

      // Close on escape
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          hamburger.focus();
        }
      });

      // News carousel touch/drag support
      var carousel = document.querySelector('.news-carousel');
      var isDragging = false;
      var startX, scrollLeft;

      carousel.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        isDragging = true;
        carousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        startX = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        scrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var x = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        var walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
        carousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
      });
    })();
  </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --black: #000000;
      --purple: #7638FA;
      --orange: #FF7A00;
      --magenta: #D946EF;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F9FAFB;
      --gray-100: #F3F4F6;
      --gray-200: #E5E7EB;
      --gray-300: #D1D5DB;
      --gray-400: #9CA3AF;
      --gray-500: #6B7280;
      --gray-600: #4B5563;
      --gray-700: #374151;
      --gray-800: #1F2937;
      --gray-900: #111827;
      --gradient-brand: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--magenta) 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      --gradient-hero: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #C026D3 40%, #FF7A00 100%);
      --font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --max-width: 1200px;
      --transition: 200ms ease;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--gray-900);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    /* ===== HEADER ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      color: white;
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .btn-login {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-login:hover {
      border-color: var(--gray-900);
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .hamburger-icon {
      width: 22px;
      height: 16px;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .hamburger-icon span {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 250ms ease;
      transform-origin: center;
    }

    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
    }
    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .hamburger.active .hamburger-icon span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
    }

    /* Mobile nav */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 64px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 99;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: opacity 250ms ease, transform 250ms ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: all;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 14px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gray-900);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn-login-mobile:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 160px 24px 100px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(118,56,250,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -150px;
      left: -150px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,122,0,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .hero h1 .gradient-text {
      background: var(--gradient-hero);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(118,56,250,0.4);
    }

    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .btn-primary svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    /* ===== SECTION LAYOUT ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES ===== */
    .features {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .content-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .content-card-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .content-card-text p {
      font-size: 17px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      transition: gap var(--transition);
    }

    .section-link:hover { gap: 10px; }

    .section-link svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
    }

    .content-card-visual {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
    }

    .visual-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .features .content-card-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #A855F7 50%, #D946EF 100%);
    }

    .features .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 180px;
      height: 180px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      top: 20%;
      right: 15%;
    }

    .features .visual-placeholder::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      bottom: 15%;
      left: 10%;
      transform: rotate(15deg);
    }

    /* ===== SAFETY ===== */
    .safety {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .safety .content-card {
      direction: rtl;
    }

    .safety .content-card > * {
      direction: ltr;
    }

    .safety .content-card-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4 0%, #3B82F6 50%, #6366F1 100%);
    }

    .safety .section-link {
      color: #3B82F6;
    }

    .safety .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 100px;
      height: 100px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 25%;
      left: 20%;
    }

    .safety .visual-placeholder::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 60px;
      height: 60px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 30%;
      left: 25%;
    }

    /* ===== CREATORS ===== */
    .creators {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .creators .content-card-visual {

    .creators .section-link {
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .creators .visual-placeholder::before {
      content: '';

      height: 200px;

      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);

    /* ===== TAGLINE BANNER ===== */

    .tagline-banner::before {

      left: -100px;

      height: 300px;
      border-radius: 50%;

    .tagline-banner::after {

    .tagline-banner h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -1px;

    /* ===== NEWS ===== */
    .news {
      background: var(--gray-50);

    .news-header {

    .news-label {

    .news-header h2 {

    .news-view-more {

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .news-card {

    .news-card:nth-child(1) .news-card-thumb {

      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #FBBF24 100%);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6 0%, #06B6D4 100%);
    }
    .news-card:nth-child(4) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #34D399 100%);
    }

    .news-card-thumb-icon {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 20px 24px 24px;
    }

    .news-card-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;

    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

      padding: 96px 24px;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .cta-download-inner {
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .cta-download h2 .gradient-text {
      background: var(--gradient-hero);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .cta-download .subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 40px;

    .store-buttons {

      gap: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);

    .store-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      background: var(--black);
    }

    .store-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .store-btn svg {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .store-btn-text {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .store-btn-label {

      opacity: 0.7;
      font-weight: 500;

      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;

    .footer-divider {

    .footer-bottom {

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .footer-lang {

      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-300);
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-lang:hover { border-color: var(--gray-500); }

    .footer-lang svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .footer-social a svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-legal a:hover { color: var(--white); }

    .footer-legal .sep {
      color: var(--gray-600);
      font-size: 13px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */

      .footer-columns {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav { display: block; }
      .btn-login { display: none; }

      .hero { padding: 120px 20px 72px; }

      .content-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
      }

      .safety .content-card {
        direction: ltr;
      }

      .content-card-visual { order: -1; }
      .section { padding: 64px 20px; }

      .tagline-banner { padding: 56px 20px; }

      .news { padding: 64px 0; }
      .news-header { padding: 0 20px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; }
      .news-carousel { padding: 0 20px 12px; }
      .news-card { flex: 0 0 290px; }

        gap: 28px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {

        align-items: flex-start;
      }

    }

    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {

        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }

    (function() {
      var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      var mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
      var isOpen = false;

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        isOpen = !isOpen;
        hamburger.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
        mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
        document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
      });

      var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a');
      mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
        link.addEventListener('click', function() {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
        });
      });

      // Close on escape
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
          isOpen = false;
          hamburger.classList.remove('active');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
          mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          hamburger.focus();
        }
      });

      // News carousel touch/drag support
      var carousel = document.querySelector('.news-carousel');
      var isDragging = false;
      var startX, scrollLeft;

      carousel.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        isDragging = true;
        carousel.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        startX = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        scrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.cursor = '';
      });

      carousel.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var x = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
        var walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
        carousel.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
      });
    })();
  </script>

steps.message:
The SnapFrame corporate About landing page is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Sections (in order):** Hero with gradient "SnapFrame" text + "Try it now" CTA, Features (purple visual), Safety (blue visual, reversed layout), Creators (orange visual), Tagline banner with full gradient background, News carousel (4 horizontally scrollable cards with drag support), CTA Download with App Store/Google Play buttons, and a dense 6-column footer.

**Key interactions:**
- **Hamburger menu** — toggles mobile nav overlay with animated icon (X transition), closes on Escape key, locks body scroll
- **News carousel** — horizontal scroll with `scroll-snap`, mouse drag support, touch-swipeable on mobile, hidden scrollbar
- **Responsive** — breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px; footer collapses from 6→3→2→1 columns; content cards stack vertically on mobile

**Design system:** Plus Jakarta Sans (800/700/600/500/400 weights), brand gradient (#7638FA → #D946EF → #FF7A00), light background with vibrant accent sections, rounded UI (12-24px radius), SVG icons throughout, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, visible focus states, and WCAG-compliant contrast.
